entities.title: TypeScript example tests
entities.summary: The library's examples, as unit tests: the UTV-first and native-first suites, and the shared fixture they use for zone rules.
entities.purpose: Groups the two example suites of docs/example-tests.md and holds fixtures.ts, whose demoZoneRules() loads the pinned rules of conformance/rules/demo-zones.json for every UTV zone operation in the examples, with its own test.
boundaries: The examples follow AGENTS.md: GIVEN … THEN sections, one doc comment with "Verifies that …" and "Compared with: …", role-prefixed names.
UTV zone operations use demoZoneRules(), never the host's tz database; the Intl.DateTimeFormat comparisons necessarily read the host's.
